title: Custodied Crypto Assets Register
description: Extension schema for the vwp-digital-assets-custody-safeguarding extension: the register at facts/custodied-assets.json. One entry per population of crypto assets the entity safeguards for others, with the units and dated price that value it for disclosure, the role the entity plays, the evidence that the keys are controlled, and the ASC 450-20 loss-contingency assessment (SAB 122 rescinded the SAB 121 gross-up: a liability is recognized only when a loss is probable and estimable). The validators check that every holding links a resolvable judgment, that the fair value recomputes from a price fact dated asOf, that control evidence resolves, and that a recognized liability exists only when the loss is probable and estimable.

wallet.description: Address, vault or account label the population sits in.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in the register currency as of asOf.

priceFact.description: Fact id whose value is {price, date}: price = unitPrice, date = asOf.

fairValue.description: units x unitPrice, for the disclosure of custodied assets.

holderRole.description: custodian: the entity holds the keys for customers; subCustodian: a third party holds the keys under the entity's arrangement with its customers; agent: the entity arranges custody but has no safeguarding obligation.

subCustodian.description: Label of the third-party key holder when holderRole is subCustodian.

obligationToReturn.description: Whether the entity is obligated to return the assets (or their value) to the customers — the SAB 122 safeguarding obligation.

controlEvidenceRef.description: Evidence or fact id proving who controls the keys or addresses (signed message, test transaction, sub-custodian statement). Required when obligationToReturn is true.

lossProbable.description: ASC 450-20-25-2(a): a loss from the safeguarding risk is probable.

lossEstimable.description: ASC 450-20-25-2(b): the loss is reasonably estimable.

recognizedLiability.description: The ASC 450-20 accrual for this population in the register currency; nonzero only when lossProbable and lossEstimable.

judgmentRef.description: Judgment id concluding on the safeguarding obligation and the loss-contingency assessment for this population.
